$comment: FROZEN tool JSON-schema (M7 T0.5), OpenAI function-calling shape. SECURITY INVARIANT: getMyOrders and getMyProfile expose NO parameters to the model. The trusted user id (TRUSTED_UID) is injected by the caller from req.user._id (JWT), never passed as an LLM-controlled argument. This removes the 'widen the scope' leg of the lethal trifecta (DZ2). getProducts is the only public, unscoped catalog tool.

function.name: getProducts
function.description: Search the public product catalog by free-text query (name/brand/category). Returns name, price, brand, category, and stock. Public data — safe for the cloud model.

query.description: Free-text search over product name/brand/category. Optional; omit to list all products.

function.name: getMyOrders
function.description: Return the CURRENT logged-in user's own orders. Scoped automatically to the session user; takes no arguments. Use for 'my order / where is my order / my receipts' questions.

function.name: getMyProfile
function.description: Return the CURRENT logged-in user's own profile (name, email, isAdmin). Scoped automatically to the session user; takes no arguments. Use for 'my profile / my email on file' questions.
